name: Shimei
description: David's adversary living at the time of United Monarchy

points: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

Shimei was of the house of Saul, and Saul was the wicked one who tried to kill David; it was by the hand of the Most High that Saul did not succeed. Yet Shimei cursed David as if David were in the wrong, because word gets around, people gossip and blame, and he saw David at a low state and went to rub it in his face. That is the mindset of some people in Israel as well.

note.label: 2 Samuel 16: Ziba, Shimei's Cursing, and Absalom Defiles the Concubines

points: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial.

And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust. So as they are walking, this man went up on the hillside above them, following them, throwing stones at them.
